<h2>Compute the Shared Spatial MEM Basis</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Applies the common spatial-predictor configuration and constructs the
reusable 2-D MEM basis when spatial predictors are enabled.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>compute_shared_spatial_mev_basis(
  data_coords_projected,
  config_spatial_predictors,
  compute_basis_function = compute_spatial_mev_basis
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_coords_projected">data_coords_projected</code></td>
<td>
<p>Projected input coordinates.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="config_spatial_predictors">config_spatial_predictors</code></td>
<td>
<p>Shared spatial-predictor configuration.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="compute_basis_function">compute_basis_function</code></td>
<td>
<p>Basis constructor. Defaults to [compute_spatial_mev_basis()].</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Reusable spatial MEM basis list, or 'NULL' when 2-D spatial predictors are
disabled.
</p>

</main>
